nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Did Hector Alonzo just ask if he could join the cheerleading squad?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think he did.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector, do you seriously want to join the squad?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes. It's really important!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, then start by answering the obvious question: why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, I shouldn't have to explain my reasons. Just let me try out!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Actually, Hector, given what's at stake, your reasons are super-important.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I mean, look at you. You're cool. Not Keiler Taulner cool, but you've got that rogue D.J. angle working for you.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Not to mention, you're dating a total hottie...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Why would you even contemplate committing first-degree rep-icide?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why are you two trying to talk me out of this? We both know...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! Getting caught like that, what was I thinking? Total amateur hour.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not to worry, though. I'll totally make it up to her with date package 13F.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll start with a picnic by the East Ayeville waterfall, take a tandem bicycle ride through the old apple orchard... Then watch the sunset from the top of Shou Ravine. Classic.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, what are you doing? I thought you liked Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! Of course, I do! I like her more than anything!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then why are you even contemplating using one of your 'standard' date packages? Amanda wants to feel special. You should do something unique for her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wow... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Unique?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! See, the thing is... I didn't even consider how Amanda would feel if she found out I'd been on the same date with other girls.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I mean... For me, dates are all about who you're with, not what you're doing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But now that I've thought about it, I can see how going on one of my 'date packages' would freak Amanda out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She really likes me and wants to make sure that I feel the same way about her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not sure. I'm going to have to think of a way to prove my loyalty. I need to do something I would never do for any other girl.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, Hector... I think that sounds like a great idea.
The next day before school starts, Hector and Howard play toss with a football in the quad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I said, 'go long', bro! Why are you just standing there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'm just not feeling it today, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah? Everything all right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, Amanda and I went to dinner and then took a walk on the boardwalk last night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Date package 47C, right? Excellent choice.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it would've been, only the waitress showed up with a complimentary cake celebrating my one hundredth dinner there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ouch. How did Amanda take it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She was pretty mad, but... The thing is, I'm mad at me too. I really should've...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... You think a better song could help the team win?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't just think it... I know it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But what can we do about it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not sure what 'we' can do... But me? I can do a lot!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: After I drop you off, I plan to drop the needle on some vinyl dance singles.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're going to sew me a quilt?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, no... But I will find the perfect song for our big routine!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You... You're just trying to cheer me up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, I'm not! I mean it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure, the squad has problems. The dance moves are a little sloppy. Some of the tricks are landing off-rhythm... But it's all fixable.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It is...?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Totally! I think the problem is with the music. The squad needs a remix with a more danceable groove.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know, something to make sure everyone stays in sync.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Huh! That actually makes sense. Before she was suspended, Paula always chose the music our squad would perform to.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor is a great team captain, but she doesn't have the best ear for tunes.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How would you know? You don't even know our routines, and now you're supposed to be an expert on cheerleading competitions?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, that's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's a Liberty to Scorpion to Chin-Chin?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's a Kick Twist Basket Toss to Show and Go?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's a flashing red light mean?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, you better figure it out, because we're headed right for it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait! What?!
Hector slams on the brake, stopping just short of the intersection. Several vehicles honk their horns angrily.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, all I'm saying is that we'll never win with a negative attitude!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I mean... On the nights I'm going to DJ a party, what do I do? I lay down the rockin'-est track in my collection and I psych myself up! I make myself believe I can do it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I think you just gave me one of those things I never get!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean, an idea?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes! One of those! Before she was suspended, Paula always chose the music our squad would perform to.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor is a great team captain, but she doesn't have the best ear for tunes.
That evening, Hector gives Amanda a ride home...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, I'm really sorry about today. I really meant to go over those routines, I just got distracted, and...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The truth is, it wouldn't have made a difference anyway.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait... What?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Didn't you see us out there? The squad was all over the place.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ever since Paula was suspended for stealing the prom tiara, we can't seem to function as a eunuch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm really hoping you meant 'unit'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whatever. All I know is we're going to lose the County Cheer-Off for sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. We're not...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, I meant to practice! I did! But Travis and Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Say no more. I know from personal experience that those guys have a real problem with male cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That doesn't let you off the hook... But I'm happy you were honest.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, Hector. This routine involves a flip. If you'd attempted to perform it without knowing what was coming, Jessica could've gotten seriously hurt.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You should switch places with Maria and watch what she does before you try this yourself.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, girls...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And `guys...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]guys...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's see what you've got!
With Hector and Maria swapped, the cheerleading squad performs the trick. Jessica is tossed high in their air...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: WheeeEEEeee!!!
And is caught by Keith and Maria.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Overall that was a good job!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector, you're the guy. Next time, you should swap positions with Maria so that you'll be in position to make the catch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now that I've seen the trick, the rest of this practice should go smoothly.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Will do!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: For sure! I mean, that's the reason I was late. I was studying the routines, and I totally lost track of time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow! I'm glad to see you're taking this so seriously.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, girls...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And `guys...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]guys...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's see what you've got!
The cheerleading squad performs the trick. Jessica is tossed high in the air...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: WheeeEEEeee!!!
And crashes down on top of Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ooof!!!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing, you idiot?! You were supposed to catch me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry! I guess I messed up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't understand... You said you memorized all the routines?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: No way. Look at that guilty face. Hector only `said` he memorized the routines.
nodes.text_bbcode: No way. Look at that guilty face. Hector only [color=#e23b3b][i]said[/i][/color] he memorized the routines.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, is this true?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm afraid... I'm afraid so.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't just stand there. Somebody help me over to the bleachers! I think I hurt my ankle!
The school nurse is summoned to the field. After a quick inspection, she states her diagnosis.

nodes.speaker: Nurse
nodes.text: Jessica was very lucky. She only suffered a minor strain. She'll be ready for the County Cheer-Off.

nodes.speaker: Nurse
nodes.text: But you cheerleaders really need to be more careful during practice.
Half an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're late, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know. I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: At least, you're in time to practice the S.P.L.I.T. maneuver we'll be performing at the County Cheer-Off. Now get in formation!
Hector turns to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Better late than never, I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I told you to take this seriously.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know! I tried, but...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: At least, you're here. You did remember to go over the routines, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have the capability to produce the world's greatest, most booty shakin'-est remix.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The music will be better, thumpin'-er, and no fewer than fifteen beats per minute faster.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, Hector... Why are all the lights off? And why are you playing the theme song to 'The Seven Gazillion Dollar Guy'?
Hector switches on the lights.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm trying to psych myself up. Didn't you get my message?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but all you said is that you needed my help.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I do! Somewhere in this massive mountain of vinyl is the tune that will propel the Centerscore High Cheerleading Squad to victory at the County Cheer-Off!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have exactly twelve hours to find it. Will you help me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, I guess. What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I need you to organize these records while I listen through the cuts. Can you do it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure... No problem.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's the last record! We've now been through your entire collection.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you find the song you were looking for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Hector. Are you okay? You seem kind of...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The year was 1990. It was a simpler time. The Cold War was over. Ireland elected a female president...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And this track, 'Suave is in the Cardiac Muscles' by Wee-Lux, climbed to number four on the Leaderboard Flaming Hot One Hundred.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Suave is in the Cardiac Muscles'? That's the song?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It is... `THE SONG!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It is... [color=#e23b3b][i]THE SONG![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now all I need to do is lay down a heavier bass line, ramp the BPM's to ensure maximum cheer-liciousness, and then rip it to the MusicBoxx you brought over.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, you need to play through these albums faster. This stack of records is becoming totally unstable.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bum dum dum...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, are you even listening to...?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: BUM bum...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Hector, watch out!
The precariously stacked records topple over!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard?! What did you do?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me? You were the one who fell behind. If you'd been listening faster, this never would've happened.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I was spinning pretty slow.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, there's no time to listen to all these records again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess I'll just have to go with the track I'm listening to now, even if it isn't ideal.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll just lay down a heavier bass track and rip it to the MusicBoxx you brought over.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You did bring your MusicBoxx, right? I specifically mentioned it on the message I left for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, about that...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: ...Come over immediately. And remember to bring your...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No! Barnabus, come back!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: COME BACK!!!

nodes.speaker: Barnabus
nodes.text: SNORT! SNORT!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Was that a badger that just ran by?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah... We accidentally caught it in the badger trap we accidentally left in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're going to ask mom if we can keep him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, that sounds... You know what? Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Something tells me I'm better off staying out of this.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: See you in thirty. And thanks, bro. You're the best! Bye!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The thing is... I might've been a little distracted when I checked your message earlier.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But why do you even need it? Don't you have one?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I did, but then Amanda tried to play a song for her goldfish and... Never mind!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, the Cheer-Off is in less than an hour! There won't be enough time to do the remix `and` swing by your house to pick up the MusicBoxx...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, the Cheer-Off is in less than an hour! There won't be enough time to do the remix [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] swing by your house to pick up the MusicBoxx...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There's just no way I'll be able to play this new remix at the competition, unless...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Unless?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes!!! Unless!!!
Like a man possessed, Hector scrambles around the room. He gathers speaker wire and a portable public address system...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't just stand there, Howard! We've got work to do!
Meanwhile, at the Centerscore County Cheer-Off Event...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. He's your boyfriend. Where is he? They're going to call us up to do our routine any second now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I don't know. He said he was going to try and find some new music for us, but...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, I know my music selection wasn't perfect, but we have to perform something.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Please, Taylor, give Hector another minute...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Because I... I trust him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You do? After everything he did?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes. I mean... Sure, Hector joined the cheerleading squad for the wrong reasons, but I know his heart is in the right place.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He'll show. We just need to give him more time.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Attention! The Centerscore High School Lizards should now proceed to the ready station.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Amanda. Wherever Hector's heart is... It isn't `here.`

nodes.title: The Cheer- Lationship
nodes.subtitle: Can Hector help win the Cheer-Off?

nodes.text: It's Friday night, and Hector and Amanda are on a date!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: More sparkling water, my dear?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It bubbles!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just like your personality!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know, ever since we started going out, I've been hoping we could enjoy a romantic date together.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know! Me too! I wish I weren't so busy with cheerleading practice...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor is making us do two practices a day to prepare for the Centerscore County Cheer-Off.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She even wants to perform a S.P.L.I.T. maneuver for the finale.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't you do splits all the time?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Not splits, S.P.L.I.T. It stands for `Split Prep Lift to Inverted Toss.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not splits, S.P.L.I.T. It stands for [color=#3b78e2][i]Split Prep Lift to Inverted Toss.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The problem is, we need two guys, and right now we've only got Keith.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Too bad we can't find someone else to join the squad.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, forget about all that. I want you to have fun tonight. I know you're busy, but we finally found time for a date.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know, just the two of us. No cheerleading practice. No Boot Camps. No Crosstown Races...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nothing between you and me... But our supple lips.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Ahem... Monsieur, Madame, I present to you... Your dessert!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow! That's a big cake!
